status: frozen metadata-only admission protocol; no new lensing coordinates, lens maps, residuals, Sigma action, or universal constants opened or selected
purpose: Build a genuinely diverse future raw-lensing holdout without confusing public availability with scientific eligibility and without spending the holdout before the Sigma equation is frozen.

alias_audit.scope: tracked project files excluding data/raw and the large environment lock
alias_audit.meaning: A zero result shows that the exact alias was absent from tracked analysis-bearing files at the audit cutoff. It does not by itself make the system an eligible holdout.

public_source_universes.scientific_role: candidate universe and later same-catalog comparator source; inferred kappa and gamma maps are never validation truth

public_source_universes.scientific_role: source-side gas readiness and state stratification before any raw lensing coordinate is opened

available_metadata: public lens-model products for a subset
public_source_universes.scientific_role: reserve candidate universe only; model availability is not evidence that the raw-image or baryon-completeness gates pass

known_non_holdout_examples.reason: The Frontier Fields are already present in tracked project analyses or inputs and therefore cannot be represented as untouched future holdouts.
Public availability is insufficient: the published analysis uses one secure three-image source family, below the frozen minimum of three families and eight images.

admission_sequence.name: identity_and_spend_audit
admission_sequence.allowed: canonical names, aliases, archive identifiers, redshift, sky coverage and prior project use
admission_sequence.forbidden: raw multiple-image coordinates, lensing residuals, convergence maps and shear maps

admission_sequence.name: source_side_readiness
admission_sequence.allowed: stars, gas, BCG, intracluster light, member catalog, exposure, PSF, masks, source-state morphology and uncertainties
admission_sequence.forbidden: using any lens-derived mass map to repair the baryonic source model

admission_sequence.name: constraint_count_and_covariance_metadata
admission_sequence.allowed: family count, spectroscopic-family count, image count, stated positional-error rule and comparator identity
admission_sequence.forbidden: image coordinates, parity, topology, critical curves, model maps and target residuals

admission_sequence.name: freeze_final_six_and_payload_hashes
admission_sequence.allowed: cluster IDs, strata, source-input manifests and sealed target-file hashes
admission_sequence.forbidden: opening target-file contents before the action and universal constants are frozen

admission_sequence.name: open_once_and_score
admission_sequence.allowed: open raw target coordinates exactly once after theory freeze and score the preregistered metrics
admission_sequence.forbidden: changing the action, constants, cluster selection or scoring rule after any target is opened

cross_domain_prediction_ladder.why_now: They use the same quasistatic Weyl potential, resolved baryons and merger source state needed for the strong-lensing test.
cross_domain_prediction_ladder.distinctive_failure: A formula that fits rotation speeds and radial deflection but misses cross shear, critical-curve orientation or merger offsets has the wrong spatial response, not merely the wrong amplitude.

cross_domain_prediction_ladder.why_now: These become meaningful after the three-dimensional time-dependent field and its energy flow exist.
cross_domain_prediction_ladder.distinctive_failure: A smooth long-wave field may change environmental forces and global precession, but it cannot claim compact subhalo gaps or dynamical drag unless the action actually generates compact structure or carries away energy.

cross_domain_prediction_ladder.why_now: These require the covariant background and perturbation equations and cannot be inferred from a static galaxy fit.
cross_domain_prediction_ladder.distinctive_failure: If the field cannot preserve early gravitational potentials and seed the observed growth history without cold dark matter, a late-time galaxy success is not a dark-matter replacement.

priority.optimize_first: diverse galaxy morphologies plus relaxed and disturbed raw-lensing clusters
priority.evaluate_next: weak lensing and merger offsets from the same frozen metric, followed by satellite, stream and friction predictions
priority.retain_as_later_hard_veto: Solar-System, PPN, propagation speed, stability and causal initial-value constraints

claim_boundary: The eight named systems are a metadata-only shortlist, not admitted holdouts and not evidence for Sigma Gravity.
Published dynamical-state labels are source-side stratification variables; they do not supply the gravity target.
No shortlist member advances until its raw-family counts, positional covariance, complete baryons and comparator can all be verified without opening image coordinates.
The final six remain unselected, and their raw target payload remains sealed until one action and at most five universal constants are frozen.
The other-phenomena ladder states predictions the theory owes; it does not count them as passed tests.
